value: FULL UI REDESIGN — 7 phases: P1=Design Foundation (CultivationTheme + 13 shared components), P2=Navigation restructure (4-tab MainAppView), P3=Garden Tab hero screen (grouped list, quick card, bed headers), P4=Home Tab (task dashboard), P5=Journal+Profile restyle, P6=Detail views + sheets, P7=Polish+cleanup. Tests run on mac-mini via SSH. No ObservableObject/@Published. @Observable only. Accessibility identifiers required on ALL interactive elements.

FULL UI REDESIGN — Design Language: Clean Minimal + Premium. Dark bg #0c0c0c, glass cards (rgba(255,255,255,0.04) + backdrop-filter:blur(12px) + 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)). Status colors: alert=#FF453A, warning=#FFD60A, healthy=#30D158. CTA gradient: #2d6a4f→#52b788. Headlines use .fontDesign(.rounded). Hero sections: near-black bg + subtle green glow orb. Tinted icon bubbles everywhere. Spring animations on all interactions. Spec at: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-03-09-full-ui-redesign-design.md

FULL UI REDESIGN — Navigation: 4 tabs (was 7). Home=task dashboard (today's care tasks, urgency grouped), Garden=grouped plant list by bed/area (hero screen), Journal=timeline, Profile=settings+learning. Garden is the center of gravity. Grouped list primary view — plants grouped by bed/container/area, sorted by care urgency within each group. Optional layout planning mode via toolbar. Plant tap → bottom sheet quick card → full detail push. Spec at: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-03-09-full-ui-redesign-design.md
